text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday. To think the little one 
who used to follow me around has grown up 
so splendidly."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As a celebration, I sent a banyan tree 
sapling to your room. Check it when you 
get back.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. If I recall 
correctly, this is the 'Tree of 
Happiness,' right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Only you can grasp your own 
happiness. Even so, let me at least pray 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Those words are the greatest gift of 
all. Ever since we were little, I've 
always been the one receiving from you, 
Sis Groove."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. Ah... right, if a 
banyan tree gets too big, you won't be 
able to keep it in your room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Prune it from spring to autumn, and adjust 
it so it stays compact.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No... I won't keep it small. Once it grows 
up, I'll send it to my family back home.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am who I am today thanks to you. Just as 
you nurtured me, I promise I'll raise this 
tree into something magnificent...!
